property_summary: For any caller, calling setOwner(_owner) must only succeed when the caller is the admin; the bug lets the current owner also change the owner, so after an owner's call to setOwner(newOwner), P.owner() remains unchanged while M.owner() becomes newOwner.
change_summary: Replace `require(msg.sender == admin` with `require(msg.sender == owner` so the check passes for the current owner instead of admin.
